name: Alejandro Tabilo
intro: Alejandro Tabilo is a lefty from Chile. His friends call him Jano. He was born in Canada. He plays for Chile, his parents' home.
story: Jano started tennis by copying his big brother Sebastian. At 13 he left home to train in Florida. Later he moved to Chile and became the country's best player. In 2024 he shocked the world by beating Novak Djokovic in Rome. He did it again in 2025!

funFacts.text: His favorite food is popcorn. His guilty pleasure is ice cream.
Favorite school subject? Gym class, of course.
He was born in Toronto, Canada. His parents are both from Chile.
He beat world No. 1 Novak Djokovic in Rome in 2024.
His favorite shot is the drop shot. His idol is lefty Rafael Nadal.

watchFor: He is a lefty! Watch his serve curve out wide. Then spot his sneaky drop shot.

notes: Birth 1997-06-02 Toronto, Chilean parents, left-handed/2HBH, 188 cm, beat No. 1 Djokovic Rome 2024 and again Monte Carlo 2025, current Chilean No. 1: confirmed on Wikipedia.
Nickname Jano, brother Sebastian, left home at 13 for Florida, chess, popcorn, ice cream, gym, drop shot, Nadal idol, Superman: all confirmed on ATP bio page.
Hometown Santiago: tennismajors interview ('When I was around 18, I moved to Santiago').
